unresolved.detail: Exact wheel-vendored GCC runtime versions, patches and build inputs for NumPy/SciPy/PySCF/RDKit are not established; generic Debian GCC sources do not prove correspondence.
SciPy development OpenBLAS commit and NumPy/PySCF BLAS exact build provenance remain absent.
Exact h5py-vendored HDF5/libaec/libsz build source versions/patches and build inputs remain unestablished.
PySCF recipe, candidate XCFun source and patch applicability exist; actual wheel patch application/build records remain unknown.

RDKit/Pillow wheel native libraries have actual byte hashes and parent source candidates, but exact native component source/build mapping and corresponding source obligations are incomplete. Native SONAMEs are not complete source-version evidence.

Actual Amadeus.ttf is present. The accompanying amadeus_font_license.txt says no license was provided and gives no guarantee; it does not establish redistribution permission. Obtain authoritative permission or prepare/verify a new candidate omitting it; do not change this accepted scientific image in place.

293 of 294 installed RDKit Python files match official release sources with explicit installation-path mappings. Generated RDPaths.py lacks a byte-matched source file; packaging recipe candidate exists, exact build environment/provenance is not established.

Local supplemental notices/source archives are now retained; an actual distribution tying the exact image to the required notices and corresponding source availability has not been validated or authorized.
